stories.title: Second time round: Flintshire Catholic school closure plans head back to Cabinet
stories.summary: Flintshire County Council’s Cabinet will decide on Tuesday whether plans to close four Catholic schools and build a 3-18 school in Flint move to a formal objection stage. stories.title: New NHS accountability framework unveiled by Wales’ Health Minister
stories.summary: Problems in the Welsh NHS will be spotted and addressed before they become serious issues, Wales’ health minister has said.
